component.name: PIA Bazzite
component.summary: Unofficial Private Internet Access client for Bazzite

description.p: PIA Bazzite is an unofficial desktop client for Private Internet Access on Bazzite. It creates native WireGuard connections through NetworkManager without the official manual-connections scripts.
It provides location selection, latency measurements, public-IP status, temporary IPv6 protection, a system tray, an optional live log, and English and German interfaces.

PIA Bazzite ist ein inoffizieller Desktop-Client für Private Internet Access unter Bazzite. Er erstellt native WireGuard-Verbindungen über NetworkManager, ohne die offiziellen manual-connections-Skripte zu benötigen.
First public release with AppImage packaging, final PIA shield icons, native Plasma tray behavior, English and German UI, and GitHub release automation.
